description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Zephyr], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Enlightening Breeze Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Zephyr
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Wind abilities

description.name: Enlightening Breeze Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Enlightening Breeze after using two Wind abilities
